# Sharp Sighted Studio (the channel)

Sharp Sighted Studio at sharpsighted.studio is the community channel and
journal of Sharp Sighted, a multi-genre photography practice founded July
2022 by Dean Draper in North Texas. It is the connective tissue of the
brand: where the journal, the 10% Rule archive, the series the collective
produces, and the cross-network feed all live as a living record.

It is not a publication, a portfolio, or a sales surface. It is a
networking site for a small creative collective.

## Tagline

Stay Sharp. Stay Seen. Stay Human.

## Properties

Sharp Sighted operates four web properties:

- sharpsightedstudio.com — the umbrella hub. Routes visitors to the right
  specialist site.
- sharpsighted.photos — Portraits, headshots, lifestyle. Primary pillar: Seen.
- sharpsighted.media  — Real estate media. Primary pillar: Sharp.
- sharpsighted.studio — Community, education, the 10% Rule. Primary pillar: Human.

## Pillars

- Sharp  — Tuned. Fit. Your best self.
- Seen   — Authentic visibility. Standing in your truth.
- Human  — Community. Warmth. The 10%.

Studio's primary pillar is Human. Every branch carries every pillar; the
alignments above describe each branch's strongest center of gravity, not an
exclusion.

## What lives here

- The Journal — a multi-author blog by Dean and the small collective of
  contributors. Topics: craft, behind-the-scenes, education, community.
- The Series — six ongoing shows including Bartographer, Special Moments,
  Corridor, Home Architecture, Alpha Architect, and Ripped or Stamped.
- The 10% Rule archive — documentation of pro bono work Dean and the
  collective have done for causes aligned with the brand.
- The cross-network feed — aggregated posts from YouTube, Instagram,
  TikTok, and LinkedIn for Sharp Sighted official and vetted contributors.

## How to contribute

Sharp Sighted Studio is invite-only at the collective level, but the
journal accepts pitches from members of the Discord. See /join for
details.
